name: read_table
description: Read data from a table on a specific screen, optionally filtered by a keyword. Returns the matching rows as text.

parameters.name: screen
parameters.description: Which screen's table to read: bills, obligations, insurance, properties, maintenance, health, documents

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter keyword to match rows (e.g. 'overdue', 'paid', 'upcoming', 'HDFC', 'electricity', 'credit card'). Leave empty to read all rows.
